authorities.name: Pune Municipal Corporation - Road Department
onlineFilingSteps: Visit PMC Care (complaint.punecorporation.org) or download the PMC Care Mobile App.
Select 'Roads & Traffic' -> 'Pothole / Road Repair' category.
Upload geotagged photo, landmark name, and nearest ward office.
Submit to obtain a 10-digit PMC tracking token (e.g. PMC-2026-XXXX).

wardOffices.name: Kothrud-Bavdhan Ward Office
wardOffices.address: Near Karve Statue, Paud Road, Kothrud

wardOffices.name: Ahmednagar Road - Wadgaon Sheri Ward Office

offlineOfficeDetails.timings: Monday to Friday: 10:00 AM - 5:30 PM (Token counter closes at 4:30 PM)
documentsToCarry: 2 printed color photographs showing the defect with landmark context
Written complaint application addressed to the Ward Junior Engineer (Roads)
Government photo ID (Voter ID / Driving License) for visitor register

authorities.name: PMC - Drainage & Sewerage Maintenance Department
authorities.marathiName: पुणे महानगरपालिका - मलनिःसारण व जलनिस्सारण विभाग
authorities.hindiName: पुणे नगर निगम - जल निकासी और सीवरेज विभाग
onlineFilingSteps: Go to complaint.punecorporation.org or use PMC WhatsApp Grievance Bot (+91 96899 00002).
Send 'Drainage Emergency' with precise location and photo.
Mark 'Open Manhole' if hazardous to trigger immediate 6-hour emergency dispatch.
Receive SMS tracking with Junior Engineer assigned contact number.

offlineOfficeDetails.headOffice: Drainage Dept, 3rd Floor, PMC New Annex Building, Shivajinagar
offlineOfficeDetails.timings: 24x7 Emergency Drainage Control Room operates round the clock.
documentsToCarry: Printed complaint citing public health risk (Dengue/Malaria hazard)

authorities.name: PMC - Solid Waste Management Department (Swachh Pune)
authorities.hindiName: पुणे नगर निगम - ठोस अपशिष्ट प्रबंधन विभाग
onlineFilingSteps: Use Swachhata-MoHUA App or PMC Care Web Portal.
Snap picture of chronic dump (Chroni Spot / Kachra Kundi).
Tag locality (e.g., Baner Balewadi Phata / Viman Nagar Datta Mandir Chowk).
Sanitation Inspector (SI) is dispatched with SWaCH collection vehicle.

offlineOfficeDetails.headOffice: Solid Waste Management Cell, PMC Annex Building, Shivajinagar
offlineOfficeDetails.timings: Monday to Saturday: 8:00 AM - 4:00 PM (Sanitation Inspectors available before 11 AM)
documentsToCarry: Written petition signed by residents/society secretary if recurrent chronic spot
Photographs showing commercial debris or unsegregated dumping

authorities.name: MSEDCL (Mahavitaran) & PMC Street Light Cell
authorities.marathiName: महावितरण व पुणे मनपा विद्युत विभाग
authorities.hindiName: महावितरण और पुणे मनपा विद्युत विभाग
authorities.jurisdiction: Pune Urban Circle (Mahavitaran) / PMC Ward Electricity Cell
authorities.portalName: Mahavitaran Consumer Grievance / PMC Streetlight Cell
onlineFilingSteps: For streetlights: Dial PMC Toll Free 1800 1030 222 or log on complaint.punecorporation.org under 'Electrical Department'.
For exposed live wires / transformer sparks: Call Mahavitaran emergency 1912 immediately.
Provide Pole Number (painted in yellow on PMC poles, e.g. KOT-142) and street name.

offlineOfficeDetails.headOffice: MSEDCL Pune Circle Office, Rastapeth, Pune - 411011
offlineOfficeDetails.timings: MSEDCL 24x7 Breakdown call center. Branch offices 10:30 AM - 5:00 PM.
documentsToCarry: Pole Number or nearest consumer meter number

authorities.name: PMC - Water Supply & Pipeline Maintenance Department
authorities.hindiName: पुणे नगर निगम - जल आपूर्ति विभाग
onlineFilingSteps: Register on PMC Care under 'Water Supply' -> 'Main Pipeline Leakage / Contamination'.
Specify if water is visibly muddy, emitting foul smell, or gushing onto roadway.
Water Quality Inspection squad will be assigned within 12 hours.

offlineOfficeDetails.timings: 24x7 Water breakdown desk. Executive Engineers available 11:00 AM - 2:00 PM.
documentsToCarry: Water sample in clean transparent bottle if contamination is reported
Property tax index number / society registration

authorities.name: Pune Traffic Police & Encroachment Department
authorities.marathiName: पुणे शहर वाहतूक पोलीस व अतिक्रमण निर्मूलन विभाग
authorities.hindiName: पुणे यातायात पुलिस और अतिक्रमण विभाग
authorities.portalName: MahaTraffic App / Pune Traffic Police Portal
onlineFilingSteps: Send geo-tagged photo with vehicle number or junction to WhatsApp Helpline +91 84549 00099.
Or use MahaTraffic App -> 'Report Violation / Traffic Obstruction'.
Traffic Control Room directs nearest towing crane or beat marshal.

offlineOfficeDetails.headOffice: Pune Traffic Police Headquarters, Yerwada, Pune - 411006
documentsToCarry: Clear photograph showing vehicle number plate and obstruction
